protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: soup_message_new()/soup_message_new_from_uri() route the caller-supplied method through the method property to soup_message_set_method(), which interns it without token or whitespace validation; HTTP/1 write_headers() interpolates it directly into the request line, allowing CRLF-controlled headers or request data. Upstream issue 484 documents the same reproduced mechanism, and CVE-2026-3633 remains PUBLISHED.
